FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.title: Void Cradle
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.INITI:
A violet-black pod hangs above the ground, slowly contracting and opening. An unfamiliar relic glimmers inside.

As you approach, one of your own relics begins to tremble. A slender tendril reaches from the cradle and curls around it, waiting.

There is something here to take. And something here willing to take what you carry. Neither exchange will leave you unchanged.
Obtain Putrefaction. Obtain a random [color=#B780B0]Void Relic[/color].
Obtain Putrefaction. Corrupt a random eligible relic you own into its corresponding [color=#B780B0]Void Relic[/color]. Requires an eligible relic.
The shell parts without a sound. You take the relic. Something cold slips up your arm and vanishes beneath your skin.

The cradle is empty. Its slow pulse continues inside your chest.
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.CORRU:
The cradle chooses. A tendril plucks a relic from your belongings and draws it inside.

It returns to your palm, familiar in outline, marked with impossible patterns. You turn it over. The patterns follow a moment later.

Something inside you turns with them.
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.LEAVE:
You step away. The tendrils linger, then withdraw.

Only after you have walked some distance do your relics stop trembling.
